The Tent That Glows at Midnight

At FLWRPWR, we believe great flower begins with care, from the people who grow it to the way it is cultivated. We source from local, ethical growers who share our commitment to quality and thoughtful cultivation. Our premium smalls are grown with love, without harmful chemicals, and selected for their aroma, flavor, and character.

By day, the booth is all sunshine: sunflowers, daisies, and a table full of flower. By Halloween night, the same tent turns into the friendliest haunted garden in town. The string lights flicker. The pumpkins grin. The ghosts, sources confirm, are only here for the vibes.

Step inside below. Our walkable night tent is open in this very paper — wander the grass, browse the table, and round up the runaway jack-o'-lanterns before the lights go out.

Health, Wellness and Community

FLWRPWR is a women-owned cannabis brand focused on health, wellness, and community. Through FLWRPWR, we hope to celebrate women, inspire bold ideas, and encourage others to pursue what they believe in.

Tonight's attraction · The classifieds came to life

After Dark at the FLWRPWR Tent

Walk the booth at night: branded canopy, warm string lights, flower buckets, the wholesale board, and the arched mirror sign. Eight jack-o'-lanterns have rolled off the table and hidden around the yard — and three friendly ghosts keep drifting through the lights. Round up all 8 pumpkins before the 90-second candle burns down. Bump a ghost and the string lights flicker (and you lose 5 seconds). That's as scary as it gets. Promise.

🎃 Pumpkins 0 / 8 🕯️ Time 1:30 ✨ Score 0 The tent awaits…

The tent is open. If you dare. 🌙

Stroll in with the arrow keys, WASD, or the lantern pad below. Walk into a pumpkin to collect it. Friendly ghosts only — a bump just flickers the lights.

DESKTOP: WASD / ARROWS TO WALK & TURN
PHONE: HOLD THE LANTERN PAD
WALK INTO A 🎃 TO COLLECT IT
